Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 38

“Treating pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat alike, engage yourself in battle. In this way you will incur no wrong.”

The pivot of the chapter. Krishna stops arguing about outcomes and changes the subject to attitude — the same act, done in evenness, no longer binds. Karma yoga effectively begins here.
